aim.en: You can produce a measurement table in which every row names its instrument and its uncertainty, and you can say which rows break the Pravilnik.
aim.sr: Umeš da napraviš tabelu mera u kojoj svaki red navodi instrument i nesigurnost, i umeš da kažeš koji redovi ruše Pravilnik.

bring.en: A tape measure, a spirit level or a phone inclinometer, and a printed plan of the floor you measure.
bring.sr: Metar, libela ili inklinometar na telefonu i štampana osnova sprata koji meriš.

text.en: The building you are in is the first case study
text.sr: Zgrada u kojoj si je prva studija slučaja

text.en: A draft. We measure doors, corridors, thresholds, slopes, handle and switch heights, the accessible toilet and the lift car. Every row carries the instrument and its resolution. A value without an uncertainty is not a measurement, it is an impression.
text.sr: Nacrt. Merimo vrata, hodnike, pragove, nagibe, visine kvaka i prekidača, pristupačni toalet i kabinu lifta. Svaki red nosi instrument i njegovu rezoluciju. Vrednost bez nesigurnosti nije mera nego utisak.

text.en: The room agrees one thing: which measured failure we take to the faculty, and in what form.
text.sr: Sala se dogovara o jednoj stvari: koji izmereni propust nosimo fakultetu i u kom obliku.
